svg.title: Contribution activity
svg.desc: Sample data, not real activity. 718 contributions across GitHub @sample-github and GitLab @sample-gitlab from Nov 1, 2025 to Oct 31, 2026. GitHub 405, GitLab 313. 143 active days. Longest streak: 7 days. Best day: 14 on Aug 28, 2026.

text.tspan: Contributions as reported by each platform, not commits. Platforms count different activities; totals aren’t deduplicated.
